place.name: Kamieńczyk Falls
place.description: Kamieńczyk Falls (pronounced: [kaˈmjɛɲt͡ʂɨk]; Polish: Wodospad Kamieńczyka; German: Zackelfall) is the highest waterfall in the Karkonosze National Park, Lower Silesia, Poland, dropping a total of 27 metres (89 ft). It is located in the Giant Mountains in the south-western part of the country and is ranked as the third highest waterfall in Poland.
